paragraphs: Seismolog is a production-grade command-line tool written in Full-stack app — generated by cenius.ai, Apache-2.0-licensed. Seismolog is a single-file, standard-library-only Python command-line tool that records seismic events (magnitude, depth, time, place) into a local JSON store, reports the great-circle distance from any coordinate to…. Clone Seismolog, run the installer, done — you have a working product in minutes. Want to change something? Open Seismolog on cenius.ai and say what you need — a revised build ships back, ready to deploy.
